zh: 你的 agent 說：做完了。
以前，你還得自己一步步追究。
en: Until now, you had to audit it yourself — step by step.
Vacant. Install once. Use your agent as usual.
Hooks into pi, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex.
No contract. No config. No keys.

zh: 每一步，都簽進一條雜湊鏈。
en: Every step is signed into a hash chain.

zh: 沒問題時，請求和沒裝時逐位元組相同。
en: When nothing is wrong, requests are byte-identical to no install.

zh: 直到 agent 說：做完了。
Vacant 只看紀錄，查五件事：
en: Reading only the record, it checks five things:

zh: 檔案沒寫、失敗被略過、測試對不上、數字沒出處、點名的檔沒打開。
en: missing file · skipped failure · test claim mismatch · unsourced number · named file never opened

zh: 有問題，交給你之前就退回去補。
en: If something is off, it goes back — before it reaches you.

zh: 交件附上：查了什麼、改了什麼、還沒驗證什麼。
en: Delivered with a note: what was checked, what changed, what is unverified.

zh: 預註冊實測，十五回合上限下：四十二到五十三。
補回的，是說做完卻沒寫的答案。
en: Recovered: answers called done, but never written.

zh: 它不判斷對錯，只確認每一步有根據。
en: It doesn't judge right or wrong. It checks every step has grounds.

zh: Vacant。讓每一次交付，都有根據。
